name: Tinybird
description: Query your Tinybird data sources and pipes with SQL from the chat.
long_description:
Tinybird's hosted server. It lists your data sources and pipes, explores their schemas, and runs SQL against them.

Bring a Tinybird token; it travels in the URL, which is how their server reads it. A token is scoped in Tinybird itself, so a read-only one is the safe thing to paste.

auth.instructions: Paste a Tinybird token. Scope it in Tinybird first — a read-only token is enough for questions, and is what this is for.

risk.notes: Runs SQL against your Tinybird workspace, with whatever the token allows.
